sloka: दश कोटि सुवर्णस्य रजतस्य चतुर् गुणम् ।ऋत्विजः च ततः सर्वे प्रददुः सहिता वसु ॥१-१४-५१॥
transliteration: daśa koṭi suvarṇasya rajatasya catur guṇam ।ṛtvijaḥ ca tataḥ sarve pradaduḥ sahitā vasu ॥1-14-51॥

translations.english: Thereafter, with earnestness king Dasaratha bestowed a crore of gold coins to brahmins who had come to see the sacrifice.
